scientific_integrity: Complete analytic proof of the central limit and independence claims; finite computation is corroboration only; residual priority uncertainty for less-indexed geometry and probability literature.
scientific_limitations: Classical parking-function polytope and Haar ambient directions only; no quantitative convergence rate, higher generality, or independent validation. Previously known support and first-order width formulas are not claimed as new.
title: Gaussian width fluctuations of classical parking-function polytopes and their exposed vertex layers
